messages.subject: Crosspred
parts:
Hello,
I am trying to plot lag response associations for values of SPI and Malaria cases associated with DNLM.
I got this error message, how do I fix it?



library(INLA)
mod.name <- c("model1")
for (j in 1:length(mod.name))
{
  coef <- model1$summary.fixed$mean
  vcov <- model1$misc$lincomb.derived.covariance.matrix
  print(coef)
  # create indicators for terms associated with SPI cross-basis
  indp <- grep("basis_SPI",model1$names.fixed)
  # extract predictions from the SPI DLNM centred on zero (normal conditions)
  predp <- crosspred(basis_SPI, coef = coef[indp], vcov = vcov[indp,indp],
                     model.link = "log", bylag = 0.5, cen = 0)
  # define range limits
  minlim <- min(lag_SPI, na.rm = T)
  print(minlim)
  maxlim <- max(lag_SPI, na.rm = T)
  print(maxlim)
  # contour plot of exposure-lag-response associations
  pdf(paste0("C:/Bayesian/Test1/",lab[j],"_SPI.pdf"), width = 6.5, height = 6)
  y <- predp$predvar
  x <- seq(0, nlag, 0.5)
  z <- t(predp$matRRfit)
  print(y)
  print(x)
  print(z)
  pal <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "PRGn"))
  levels <- pretty(c(0, z, 2), 20)
  col1 <- colorRampPalette(pal[1:6])
  col2 <- colorRampPalette(pal[6:11])
  cols <- c(col1(sum(levels < 1)), col2(sum(levels > 1)))
  filled.contour(x, y, z,
                 xlab = "Lag", ylab = "SPI", main = "",
                 ylim = c(minlim, maxlim), col = cols,levels = levels,
                 plot.axes = { axis(1, at = 0:nlag, seq(0,nlag,1))
                   axis(2)})
  mtext(side = 2, at = max(y)*1.2, text = lab[j], las = 2, cex = 1.2, line = 2)
  dev.off()
}
